summary: Comprehensive testing of new Stripe configuration and Access Statistics features completed. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend admin and member PWA flows working correctly with real chart data and payment alerts.
passed_tests: Admin login as super_admin (admin@gymaccess.com / admin123)
Admin login as gym_admin (admin@fitzone.com / admin123)
GET /api/access/stats/daily?days=7 returns 7 daily access entries with date, day_name, accesos, entradas
GET /api/access/stats/daily?days=14 returns 14 daily entries
GET /api/access/stats/hourly returns 24 hourly entries with hour and accesos
GET /api/access/stats/member/{member_id}?days=30 returns member attendance data with total_entries, days_attended, attendance_rate, daily_breakdown, recent_logs
PUT /api/gyms/{gym_id}/stripe-config saves Stripe secret key and currency
GET /api/gyms/{gym_id}/stripe-config returns has_stripe_key, masked_key, currency
GET /api/gyms/{gym_id}/has-payments returns payment availability (public endpoint)
GET /api/payments/history returns payment transaction list
GET /api/dashboard/stats returns comprehensive stats
GET /api/access/stats returns access summary
Admin Dashboard shows real BarChart with daily access data (not mock)
Admin Dashboard shows stat cards: Socios Activos, Accesos Hoy, Membresías Activas, Ingresos del Mes
Admin Dashboard shows capacity bar (1 de 100 socios - 1%)
Admin Settings page shows Stripe configuration section with key input, currency selector, save button
Admin Settings shows 'Stripe Configurado' status with masked key (sk_test...key)
Admin Access page shows stats summary: Total Registros, Entradas, Salidas, Socios Únicos
Admin Access page shows Export CSV button
Admin Access page shows search filter and date range filters
Member Home page shows payment alert when membership is expiring (5 days)
Member Home page shows 'Pagar Ahora' button in alert
Member Membership page shows current plan with expiry badge
Member Membership page shows 'Renovar Membresía' section with plan pricing
